annotations.title: Add assets or versions to an asset

description: Make other assets or versions the NEWEST versions of asset_id (the asset that keeps its title, link and sharing), as dragging one onto another does in the Flask app. Use it when a revision was uploaded as a separate asset. A source asset id brings ALL its versions, and that source asset then stops existing: its title and link go, and its versions take asset_id's sharing. A version id moves just that version (if it was its asset's only version, that asset goes the same way). Sources are added in order; the last becomes the current version. Refused when a source is still uploading, is in another team, or is shared more narrowly than asset_id (sharing is changed in the app). No media or feedback is ever deleted; feedback stays on its version. To add NEW media as a version, use the upload tools with version_of. Results are per source; earlier ones are not undone if a later one fails.

asset_id.description: The asset that receives the versions (any of its ids)

source_ids.description: Asset or version ids to add, in order; the last becomes current
